lens: Simulated recruitment operator, first encounter: cohorts, unfinished grading, deliberate closure, outcome review and blocked-release recovery
reason: The frozen revision gives an operator substantially clearer distinctions: staffing and submitted forms no longer imply valid evidence; unknown evidence remains attention work; closure explains irreversibility, reads current coverage and reconciles uncertain writes across same-tab reloads. Batch review retains all reviewed IDs while filtering, and diagnostics identify actual rounds with bounded evidence counts and honest closed-round escalation. The supplied mobile diagnostics capture is legible, with a visible focus indicator. Public copy states the no-fee, semester offer and labels partnerships without inventing project proof; the contact journey preserves uncertain inquiries. However, individual release still exposes the older unbounded, unchecked acknowledgement path on real operator pages. That inconsistent consequential workflow prevents my agreement with the broad world-class claim. Missing hosted acceptance, approved work evidence and workload facts independently limit confidence. This is a simulated source/artifact review, not observed operator success.

findings.evidence: ReleaseButton calls useAction/runAction, whose authorizedFetch and response.json have no deadline. runAction accepts every HTTP success, including a missing/malformed body, as ok:true; a lost response returns the generic “Could not release”. ReleaseButton refreshes only for ok or released:true, so an ambiguous committed write leaves the old view with an enabled retry. This button is actually rendered in applications/[id]/page.tsx:552 and hash/page.tsx:414. The new bounded ReleaseAllButton does not cover this path.
findings.userImpact: An operator releasing one applicant can remain indefinitely at Releasing, receive false certainty from a malformed success, or retry a stale locked outcome after an unacknowledged commit. This is a source-established conditional failure, not a hosted reproduction.
findings.suggestedFix: Give individual release the bounded full-body request, validated operation receipt and explicit unknown-result reconciliation used for batch release. Refresh authoritative outcome state before allowing retry; cover stalled bodies, malformed success and commit-then-response-loss in a focused individual-release test.
